text:
carla nguyen: FYI - new customer onboarding using webhook delivery. They report partial audit payloads and signature verification errors. payloads appear truncated. :confused:

james patel: Are they hitting webhook or pulling from S3?

carla nguyen: Primary is webhook with S3 fallback. Logs show a bunch of 413s from their edge proxy, then audit-bot falling back to S3. Splunk ingestion only sees a subset of events.

anna ruiz: Large batches + KMS envelope metadata can push body size up. Some proxies / nginx default client_max_body_size = 1m.

mike o'connor: Can we get a redacted sample of the request body they received? Even a trimmed one so we can repro size.

carla nguyen: Pasting a minimal redacted example (trimmed). note: encryption envelope present, and events array ~1200 items in the real repro.

```
{ "version":"2", "tenant":"acct-123", "events": [ {"type":"auth:token.create","user":"u-1","ts":"2026-03-18T12:00:00Z"}, ... ], "encryption": { "kms_key_id":"projects/prod/keys/rdw-kms", "ciphertext":"BASE64_ENVELOPE..." } }
```

james patel: Two likely issues: (1) client_max_body_size / API gateway limits on the customer side causing truncation/413; (2) proxies modifying body encoding (transfer-encoding / gzip) which breaks signature verification.

anna ruiz: Also check the onboarding service account RBAC - last week's change removed audit.events.read for onboarding SAs in some templates. If they use the SA to validate missing events, they'd see gaps.

carla nguyen: Confirmed the SA was missing audit.events.read. Added it and re-ran internal validation -> more events visible in console, but webhook POSTs still 413.

audit-bot: Delivery attempt 4 failed for https://customer.webhook/endpoint - response 413 Payload Too Large. Next retry scheduled. :warning:

audit-bot: Last successful fallback: s3://redwood-audit-backups/acct-123/2026-03-18T12:00:00Z/

mike o'connor: Short-term mitigations: (a) reduce default webhook batch size (b) support Content-Encoding: gzip for webhooks and document it (c) add an S3-fallback verification step to onboarding.

james patel: For SIEM/Splunk customers recommend either ingesting from S3 exports or using a paginated webhook contract (events split into pages with next_page token). Add X-Redwood-Audit-Version header to help parsers.

carla nguyen: I'll add an onboarding test that POSTs a ~1.2MB gzipped sample and asserts 2xx or triggers a fallback. Will attach sample payload to the harness.

anna ruiz: I'll update the RBAC template to ensure audit.events.read is present for onboarding SAs and API keys. Also adding a doc note about edge proxies and Transfer-Encoding mutation. Link: <https://internal.redwood/docs/audit-onboard#proxy-limits>

mike o'connor: Vulnerability triage note: signature mismatches due to truncated bodies can look like MITM. We should correlate signature failures with delivery status codes (413 vs 401/403) before escalating. Mark as false-positive until delivery code verified.

james patel: Another KMS gotcha - envelope metadata or algorithm headers changing during rotation can break offline verification. Add encryption.kms_meta.version to payload so consumers can detect envelope version mismatches. Document rotation policy at <https://internal.redwood/kms-rotation>.

carla nguyen: Example curl we will add to onboarding checklist:

```
curl -X POST "https://customer.webhook/endpoint" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \\
  -H "X-Redwood-Audit-Version: 2" \\
  --data-binary @sample-audit.gz
```

anna ruiz: Action items:
- add onboarding gzip + large-payload test (carla nguyen)
- set default max_batch = 200 for webhooks and make configurable per-customer (eng-runtime)
- update RBAC onboarding template to include audit.events.read (anna ruiz)
- add S3-fallback verification step to onboarding flow (mike o'connor)
- document KMS envelope versioning and sample payloads (james patel)

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: audit-onboard-checks v1.3.2 -> staging

carla nguyen: Pushing a small canary to staging now. will report back with staging results. :eyes:

james patel: I can add Splunk HEC mapping examples to the onboarding docs if helpful.

carla nguyen: thanks all. will update thread after staging run."
